Every banana is a little radioactive
Every banana is a little radioactive
Bananas are rich
in potassium,
and about one potassium
atom in ten thousand
is radioactive.
Your body is full
of the same atoms,
hundreds of times more
than a banana.
Eating one doesn't make
you more radioactive:
your body flushes out
the extra potassium.
You're more radioactive
than the banana.
